decisions.decision: Run Phase 0 and fixed engine-contract fixtures before retraining.
decisions.basis: Round6 loader and day1 causal failures had not been separated.

decisions.decision: Retain arm_a_extended only as an excluded failed reproduction and rerun as arm_a_extended_v1.
decisions.basis: The first implementation restarted its batch RNG after initialization; v1 exactly reproduced every Round6 epoch-10 array before extending training.

decisions.decision: Evaluate capacity and quantity-ledger changes separately.
decisions.basis: Arm B improved old diagnostic-test metrics, while the ledger-only archive still failed the causal day1 feed.

decisions.decision: Add the explicitly classified task-completion executor.
decisions.basis: Pure Arm A/B/C did not turn the learned pickup into feed completion; this arm is not reported as pure BC.

decisions.decision: Create V3 after the V2 development pilot by changing only the livestock service budget.
decisions.basis: V2 completed livestock work but consumed too much workforce and suppressed crop/land work. V3 uses all workers only when there are at most two; otherwise it reserves roughly two thirds for the learned non-livestock policy.
decisions.status: post-pilot development change; not preregistered before the V2 pilot

decisions.decision: Run the preregistered 48-game development set for V3, then stop.
decisions.basis: V3 improved V2 pilot lifecycle metrics, but the 48-game result was 0 wins, 0 draws, 48 losses; the sealed gate was not met.
